name: Gemini
watchouts: Check all factual claims before use.
Do not use as a final proofreader.
Outputs can miss nuance in sensitive topics.
where: Available to all SJC staff via Google Workspace — open Gemini from the side panel in Docs, Gmail, or Slides. No additional access needed.

name: Gemini Gems
bestFor: Custom AI assistants tuned to SJC brand voice
watchouts: Gem quality depends on how well the system prompt is written.
Review and refresh Gem instructions regularly.
where: gemini.google.com — create Gems in the left panel

name: NotebookLM
watchouts: Only works with sources you upload — it cannot browse the web.
Always verify quotes pulled from sources.

name: ChatGPT
watchouts: Can hallucinate confidently — verify all facts.
Avoid pasting confidential client data.
where: chatgpt.com — use the organizational account where available
accessNote: Requires leader approval — request access from your manager.

name: Claude
watchouts: Has a knowledge cutoff — do not rely on it for current events.
Outputs should be reviewed before sharing externally.
accessNote: Requires leader approval — request access from your manager.

name: Perplexity
watchouts: Citations can be imprecise — always click through and verify.
Not a substitute for primary source journalism.

name: ClickUp AI / ClickUp Brain
watchouts: Only effective if your ClickUp workspace is well organized.
Review generated tasks before assigning.
where: app.clickup.com — Brain is built into the workspace

name: ClickUp Agents
bestFor: Content brief generation from task metadata
commonUses: Triggering brief generation when a story is approved
Assigning tasks based on team capacity
watchouts: Pilot phase — results vary. Test before relying on for deadlines.
Agent actions may need manual review.
where: app.clickup.com — Agents section in pilot workspaces

name: Otter
watchouts: Accuracy varies with audio quality and accents.
Always review transcript before quoting.

name: DeepL
commonUses: Chatelaine and Today's Parent bilingual content
watchouts: Cultural nuance may be lost — always have a native speaker review final copy.
Do not use DeepL output as final published translation.

name: Grammarly
watchouts: Do not rely on Grammarly as the only editorial check.
Style suggestions may conflict with house style.
where: grammarly.com — browser extension and desktop app

name: Looker Studio
watchouts: Visuals only reflect the quality of underlying data.
Dashboards should include data freshness labels.

name: GA4
watchouts: GA4 has a learning curve — use Looker Studio reports for simpler views.
Sampling applies to large date ranges.

name: Statera
watchouts: Internal platform — contact the Data & Analytics team for access.
Use alongside GA4, not as a replacement.

name: Canva
watchouts: Maintain brand template consistency.
AI Magic features need content review before use.
where: canva.com — use the SJC team workspace

name: Adobe Express
watchouts: Review AI-generated image suggestions for rights and appropriateness.
Use within brand color and typography guidelines.
where: adobe.com/express — included in Adobe Creative Cloud

name: MidJourney
watchouts: Do not use AI-generated images on covers without editorial approval.
Always disclose AI-generated imagery to readers.
Avoid generating images of real people.

name: Runway
watchouts: Do not use AI-generated footage of real people.
Outputs are for concept/exploration only at this stage.
Disclose AI-generated video content.

name: Submagic
watchouts: Review captions for accuracy before publishing.
Timing corrections may be needed for fast speech.

name: CapCut
watchouts: Use the business version to avoid consumer watermarks.
Review auto-captions before posting.

name: Descript
watchouts: Do not use AI voice cloning features without explicit consent.
Review transcript edits against original audio.

name: ElevenLabs
watchouts: Do not clone real people's voices without explicit written consent.
Do not use synthetic voices in published editorial audio without disclosure.
This is in early exploration — consult editorial leadership before use.

name: Sprout Social
watchouts: AI caption suggestions need brand voice review.
Confirm image rights before scheduling.

name: Sailthru
watchouts: AI personalization features need accuracy review.
Test all templates before scheduling sends.

name: Zapier
commonUses: Auto-creating ClickUp tasks from form submissions
watchouts: Automation errors can propagate quickly — test thoroughly.
Do not automate steps that require editorial judgment.

name: Supernormal
watchouts: Notify participants that the meeting is being recorded.
Review action items before distributing — assignments may be incorrect.
where: supernormal.com — connects to Google Meet and Zoom

name: Granola AI
watchouts: Do not share Granola notes externally without review.
Check that action items are attributed correctly.

name: GPTZero
bestFor: Checking AI content percentage in drafts
Verifying that copy still sounds human
commonUses: Brand voice integrity check before publishing
watchouts: Scores are probabilistic, not definitive — a high AI score does not mean the writing is wrong
Use as a signal to iterate, not a pass/fail gate
False positives exist — human writers can score as AI
Does not replace editorial judgment
